notes: Positive: prompts asking to create / refactor / validate / optimize a CLAUDE.md at any scope. Negative: prompts that should route to a sibling meta-skill (skills/agents/commands/plugins/hooks) or to nothing (writing code, writing README). Edge: ambiguous between CLAUDE.md and another component file.
